title: KCSAN: data-race in tcp_poll / tcp_recvmsg (2)
two_threads_summary: KCSAN-reported two-context race. KCSAN: data-race in tcp_poll / tcp_recvmsg (2)
audit_notes: Subject: 'tcp: annotate tp->copied_seq lockless reads'. Pre-classifier PROBABLY_GOOD (real synchronization primitives on + lines).
fix_commit_message:
7db48e983930285b765743ebd665aecf9850582b
tcp: annotate tp->copied_seq lockless reads

There are few places where we fetch tp->copied_seq while
this field can change from IRQ or other cpu.

We need to add READ_ONCE() annotations, and also make
sure write sides use corresponding WRITE_ONCE() to avoid
store-tearing.

Note that tcp_inq_hint() was already using READ_ONCE(tp->copied_seq)

Signed-off-by: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
